acceptance_scope: Explicit subset only; not full group/package acceptance
method: Exact closest projection of native extrusion segments onto measured source-core cylinders; actual G-code bead widths and layer heights, XY capsule/Z slab support bounds, additional0.025mm arc-chord tolerance. No centreline-only acceptance.
caveat: A conservative overlap is a digital hold requiring a closer slice/geometry check. A clear bound preserves only the measured core, not a physical full-diameter fit. An open axial source route does not prove intact tree-support removal.
